sentences.text: Hush... at 03:00, the sensors in the ironing room began to register a shift in the quiet air.
A cold breath started to settle, and I felt the air drying out, recorded at 46.2 %.
Oh, the deviation... this presence felt so far below the expected 50.2 %.
The chilling sensation peaked at 05:00, a sudden, sharp drop in the humidity.
This strange, dry feeling finally receded by 06:00, as the night's whispers faded.
